# SellerFee

> Free, no-signup fee and profit calculators for cross-border marketplace sellers: TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, Walmart, Etsy, Ozon, Wildberries and Yandex Market, across the US, UK, Southeast Asia and Russia. Rates come from each marketplace's official fee pages, with the verification date and source shown on every calculator.

Available in English, Chinese (简体中文), Russian and Malay. Contact: hello@sellerfee.app
